_comment: Trap Map: Research-based thesis cards with falsifiable tests. Each trap corresponds to one research piece and tracks validation status. FORBIDDEN: any language about holdings, portfolio positions, share counts, powder, IRA, buy/sell sizing, kill, kill-shot, Vote, Debait tip, or whether 'we' hold the name.

_field_definitions.id: Stable slug identifier for the trap
_field_definitions.title: Short headline for the card
_field_definitions.validation_status: WATCH = live thesis, next named print is the gate; ACT = print flipped the map for investigation (not a buy call); DROP = demoted on the map; HOLD = legacy goalposts (thesis language, not a portfolio hold — kept where ARKG still uses it)
_field_definitions.who_collects_rent: Entity/mechanism that captures economic rent first
_field_definitions.leftover: Who gets the residual after rent-collectors clear
_field_definitions.decisive_test: Single stranger-checkable test that validates or falsifies the thesis
_field_definitions.next_datapoint: Optional: { label, expected_date } for tracking upcoming prints
_field_definitions.relegate_if: Legacy mirror of drop_if (kept for backward compatibility)
_field_definitions.sources: Array of primary source labels (URLs added when available)
_field_definitions.drop_if: Conditions under which the thesis should be Dropped (public field)
_field_definitions.outlook: Optional direction near status: Positive or Negative

status_legend.WATCH: Live thesis — next named print is the gate
status_legend.ACT: Print flipped the map for investigation (not a buy call)
status_legend.HOLD: Legacy goalposts (thesis language, not a portfolio hold)

traps.outlook_note: Duration sponsorship is the price of warehousing coupons when clearance is not relief. Machine-time and tokenization can raise calm-period velocity of wealth; they do not turn stress into money, and they do not free captive absorbers from the long-end cost of capital.

traps.title: IREN — AI Cloud landlord vs leftover equity
traps.expression: Short-dated downside on spikes without proof management is executing on its plan (W3/W4).
traps.who_collects_rent: GPU lenders secured by chips and Microsoft contract cash flows — about $3.6bn Microsoft-linked capacity (about $938m drawn as of Jun 30, 2026) plus about $2.8bn other GPU financing (includes about $2.4bn Mackenzie at 9%; remainder of that package not broken out); then convertible notes about $6.75bn principal as of Jun 30, 2026; then ATM equity up to $6.0bn authorized, about $2.49bn used as of Jun 30, 2026 (same share/proceeds count restated as of Aug 14). About $3.51bn still available is desk math (authorized minus used), not a company "remaining" line; no ATM take-down 8-K through Sep 22; next hard update is the Q1 FY27 10-Q. Common is last. In order to "clear these claims," the stock must earn enough after GPU lenders, converts, and ATM dilution — and the filings do not show that yet.
traps.leftover: Common equity priced as a finished Microsoft AI Cloud landlord while AI halls are only partly accepted and the year is still mostly Bitcoin. Operating AI Cloud about 40 MW vs installed mining about 380 MW (Jun 30). Microsoft Horizon about 200 MW IT across four 50 MW Childress halls — only Horizon 1 accepted. Company targets about 0.3 GW IT cumulative in 2026 and 0.8 GW IT in 2027 (IT, not the separate gross MW targets). FY26 cash paid for PPE plus computer hardware about $4.33bn; operating cash after that about $(2.23)bn. Deferred revenue about $1.84bn; same prepayment wave added about $1.84bn to FY26 operating cash while AI Cloud GAAP was only $128.8m (June quarter $70.5m). Cash about $5.90bn unrestricted plus about $1.72bn restricted (~$7.62bn together) at Jun 30. Bitcoin mining revenue faded $232.9 → $167.4 → $111.2 → $66.7m across FY26 quarters; June quarter AI Cloud $70.5m edged Bitcoin $66.7m; full year still ~82% Bitcoin.
traps.decisive_test: Not "mining pays for AI," and not a cash-cliff ATM scare. On the named packages, GPU financing is meant to fund about 90–96% of associated GPU capex; recent customer prepayments cover about 45–55% of GPU capex. The company says it is well capitalized with existing cash and committed GPU financing and prepayments of about $14bn; separately, MD&A commitments were about $13.81bn as of Jun 30 (mostly AI hardware and site work) — two filing facts side by side, not one equated sentence. That packaging only works if several links hold: Horizons 2–4 acceptance (Horizon 1 accepted Aug 13; 2–4 targeted calendar Q4 2026, with grace language into early 2027), operating ARR from about $1bn toward $4bn by Dec 31, 2026 (ARR is not GAAP), GPU draws against live hardware, and prepaid cash converting into recognized AI Cloud rent. W1: sharp spike without Horizon acceptance / AI GAAP / first-money proof → Expression only (short-dated downside ~1 week, ~2:1); stand down if the spike is the print. W2: ATM / convert / GPU-financing 8-K into elevated tape without execution proof → same Expression. W3: Horizons 2–4 calendar Q4 2026 acceptance (check EDGAR by early Jan 2027) — miss without a new checkable date → Drop; clean on-time acceptance hurts the leftover reading. W4: Q1 FY27 10-Q (qtr ended Sep 30, 2026) AI Cloud GAAP from $70.5m and cash quality — stall near $70.5m without dated primary explanation → Drop; earnings date still unknown (date-hunt live). Spikes alone never flip status. Additional context: deferred OCF quality (prepayments); undrawn GPU debt (only about $938m of about $3.6bn Microsoft-linked package drawn); restricted cash about $1.7bn pledged/reserved; Microsoft concentration; BTC beta; about $639m FY impairments on mining kit; transition target substantially complete by Dec 31, 2026.

next_datapoint.label: Any Horizon 2–4 acceptance 8-K; IR-confirmed Q1 FY27 earnings date then that 10-Q; intervening ATM/convert/GPU-financing 8-Ks. Spikes without matching print = Expression only.
next_datapoint.expected_date: Horizon window = calendar Q4 2026 (check by early Jan 2027); Q1 FY27 10-Q after quarter ended 2026-09-30 (IR date UNKNOWN as of 2026-09-22); Expression ongoing

traps.drop_if: W3: Horizons 2–4 miss calendar Q4 2026 acceptance without a new checkable date; or W4: Q1 FY27 10-Q shows AI Cloud GAAP stuck near $70.5m without a dated primary explanation (cash check: operating cash after PPE/computer hardware vs FY26 about $(2.23)bn). W1/W2 alone never Drop.
traps.relegate_if: W3: Horizons 2–4 miss calendar Q4 2026 acceptance without a new checkable date; or W4: Q1 FY27 10-Q shows AI Cloud GAAP stuck near $70.5m without a dated primary explanation (cash check: operating cash after PPE/computer hardware vs FY26 about $(2.23)bn). W1/W2 alone never Drop.
traps.outlook_note: Leftover common overpriced vs unfinished landlord. Expression is short-dated downside on spikes without execution proof — not an Act flip.
